news.title: trunk/6fb6ef21931fa1be2b171f5f5542730663afcf86: [FSDP2] Join pending all-gather with device stream (#199677)
news.dek: FSDPParamGroup.finalize_backward may clean up an all-gather launched by backward prefetch but never consumed. It recorded a device-specific event and waited through torch.accelerator.current_stream(), whose generic Stream.wait_event does not handle that device-specific event corr
news.aiSummary: The patch addresses an issue where FSDPParamGroup.finalize_backward could clean up an all‑gather launched by backward prefetch that was never consumed. It recorded a device‑specific event and waited on torch.accelerator.current_stream(), but the generic Stream.wait_event does not support that event type. The change joins the pending all‑gather with the device stream to avoid unsupported waits.
